plan_fields.label: Why are you a fit for this role?
plan_fields.reason: Essay generated from the operator's about-me context

fields.expected:
Most of my recent work has been temporal sequence modeling and evaluation, which is the part of your voice stack I'd be most useful on quickly. At Summer Atlantic Capital I own the ML core of an anomaly-detection system: event-ingestion pipeline, RNN/Transformer-style sequence models over event streams, anomaly scoring, a learning-to-rank layer for alert prioritization, and a versioned FastAPI service behind a public detection API. I care as much about whether the output is usable as whether the metric moves, since an alert system that fires too often just creates a new problem.

At Intelehealth I designed an evaluation framework for LLM-generated clinical outputs against a 4,169-case standard, using stratified sampling to surface systematic failure modes rather than a single aggregate score. That work convinced me evaluation is usually the harder half of an AI system, which seems true for STT and TTS too, where quality judgments are noisy and easy to overfit.

I also trained a CNN in PyTorch for facial-landmark prediction to roughly 95% PCK. I have not worked on speech or audio codecs directly, but I learn by building and want to own a focused project end to end.
